name: QwenPaw v2 Personal AI Assistant
description: Always-on personal AI assistant with chat apps, memory and skills.

PORT.description: Port of the QwenPaw console and API. Railway's healthcheck and the public domain use it; keep 8088 unless you also change the domain's target port.

QWENPAW_AUTH_USERNAME.description: Console login name, generated at deploy (random on purpose: five wrong passwords lock a username for 15 minutes). Changing it later renames the account on the next restart.

QWENPAW_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Console login password (min. 12 characters), generated at deploy. Change it here to reset the password on the next restart; a password changed in the Console is kept until this variable changes.

QWENPAW_AGENT_LANGUAGE.description: Language of the default agent and its persona files, chosen on the first boot only: en, zh, ru or id. Change it later per agent in the Console.

TZ.description: IANA timezone stored as the user timezone on the first boot (e.g. Europe/Istanbul); used for cron jobs and heartbeats. Change it later in the Console.

QWENPAW_TOOL_GUARD_ENABLED.description: true forces QwenPaw's Tool Guard on (risky tool calls wait for your approval and catastrophic commands are blocked). Empty = the Console toggle decides.

QWENPAW_TOOL_GUARD_DENIED_TOOLS.description: Optional. Comma-separated tools the agent may never call, e.g. execute_shell_command to switch off shell access entirely.

QWENPAW_TELEMETRY_DISABLED.description: true = no install or daily usage pings to the QwenPaw team (nobody sees upstream's consent prompt on Railway). Set false to share anonymous environment stats.

QWENPAW_DISABLED_CHANNELS.description: Channels hidden from the Console. iMessage needs macOS and SIP needs inbound UDP, neither of which Railway offers.

QWENPAW_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Proxy networks whose X-Forwarded-For QwenPaw trusts, so login lockouts count real client IPs instead of Railway's edge. Written to security.trusted_proxies on every start; empty = trust none.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Telegram bot token from @BotFather; enables the Telegram channel. Unknown senders must be approved in the Console first.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Discord bot token (Developer Portal > Bot, enable the Message Content intent); enables the Discord channel.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Slack bot token (xoxb-...). Needs SLACK_APP_TOKEN too (Socket Mode, no public webhook).

SLACK_APP_TOKEN.description: Optional. Slack app-level token (xapp-...) with connections:write, for Socket Mode.

DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. DingTalk app Client ID (AppKey); with DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET enables the DingTalk channel (Stream mode).

FEISHU_APP_ID.description: Optional. Feishu/Lark app ID (cli_...); with FEISHU_APP_SECRET enables the Feishu channel (WebSocket long connection).

QQ_APP_ID.description: Optional. QQ bot AppID; with QQ_CLIENT_SECRET enables the QQ channel.

WECOM_BOT_ID.description: Optional. WeCom (WeChat Work) AI bot ID; with WECOM_SECRET enables the WeCom channel.

LLAMA_ARG_THREADS.description: Optional. CPU threads for in-container llama.cpp models (QwenPaw Local). Empty = derived from the container's CPU quota, capped at 8.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds the old container gets to finish running replies and flush memory before a redeploy stops it.
